title: ops content publish: usable --help and clear errors (--story, --id is a version id, --slug fails with several versions)
description: From the Anthus news desk editing session 2026-11-08: papyrus ops content publish --help prints only the usage line; --story is rejected; --id wants the VERSION id (content-item-...-v13), not the lineage; --slug fails once a story has several versions. Make --help list every option with one example; accept --story LINEAGE (publish its current version); when --id gets a lineage id say 'this is a story id: use --story or --id <story>-vN'; when --slug is ambiguous list the versions. Apply the same to unpublish. Gherkin for help text and each error message. Ties to PPY-f3b296 (stages, exit codes) and PPY-105508 (update-live --story).
